subject: Quarterly checkpoint: roadmap orchestration & launch horizon
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: leadership@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 18 Dec 2026 08:15:00 -0800
Subject: Quarterly checkpoint: roadmap orchestration & launch horizon

Team —

As we enter the final two weeks of this quarter, I want to pull a short leadership checkpoint focused on three things: roadmap orchestration across product/eng, firm launch windows for the end-of-quarter bundles, and an explicit delivery risk register we can present at the exec QBR next Tuesday.

Please review the attached risk matrix and the rough Gantt (timeline_gantt.png) before our sync. High-level asks:

- Confirm launch windows for the network-optimization and routing-config features (are we locked to 2027-01-12 and 2027-01-26 respectively?).
- Each of you: list top 3 delivery risks (technical, resourcing, external) and a short mitigation (one line).
- Highlight any procurement/security blockers that would push launches beyond the windows.

I'll collate and send a one-page for the exec deck by EOD. If you can't make the live 2pm sync, reply inline.

Attachments: Q4_launch_risk_matrix.xlsx (live working sheet), roadmap_orchestration_notes.pdf (notes from PMs), timeline_gantt.png

Thanks —
Neha Kapoor
VP, Product Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Dec 2026 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quarterly checkpoint: roadmap orchestration & launch horizon

Neha —

Quick read-through, appreciate the framing. My top items:

1) Technical debt on the runtime rollout (risk: KV cache regressions under heavy multi-tenant burst). Mitigation: extended soak on dedicated pool + feature-flagged rollout (can be done in 48 hrs).
2) Load-testing gap for 1.2M concurrent connections in the new routing path (risk: flakiness at 95th pctl latency). Mitigation: run scaled chaos tests this weekend; if we see >10% SLO miss, delay routing-config by one sprint.
3) Ops runbook completeness for fallback policies (risk: ambiguous ownership during cross-region fallback). Mitigation: assign primary/secondary on-call and run one simulated failover with PM + SRE next Tuesday.

Launch windows: I am comfortable with 2027-01-12 for network-optimization if we get the soak and runbooks done; routing-config on 2027-01-26 is optimistic unless chaos testing is green.

I'll be on the 2pm sync with a short tech-readout and an updated row in Q4_launch_risk_matrix.xlsx.

—Vivek
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Dec 2026 12:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quarterly checkpoint: roadmap orchestration & launch horizon

Adding product constraints from PM side:

- Dependency: SigmaApps integration (external) must complete E2E contract testing by 2027-01-05 or we cannot ship the bundled offering on 2027-01-12. They just flagged a schema negotiation item — their engineering lead is on copy below.
- Customer beta: two enterprise customers expect the network-optimization feature in mid-Jan; slipping the date will require offering a phased rollout and proactive comms.
- Prioritization: if routing-config slips, we should reallocate two engineers from feature X to support soak/rollout for network-optimization for 2 weeks.

I'll bring the comms draft to the sync.

Marissa
Product Lead — Growth
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Dec 2026 13:14:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quarterly checkpoint: roadmap orchestration & launch horizon

Folks —

Engineering risk items (top 3):

- Model variant compatibility (risk: subtle tokenization mismatch on quantized paths causing score drift). Mitigation: run the model-compat test-suite against quantized artifacts; if drift > 0.5% we hold the variant and use unquantized; SLA impact assessment required.
- Infra procurement (GPUs) for dedicated bursts (risk: lead times into Jan due to vendor backlog). Mitigation: confirm spare capacity in our cloud partner marketplace and toggle burst policy; apply to routing-config to reduce tail latency.
- Integration test flakiness with SigmaApps sandbox (risk: intermittent timeouts manifest only under long tails). Mitigation: run extended integration harness (48 hrs) and add circuit-breaker metrics + alerting.

I'm noting Jira INF-4729 for the model-compat tests. Will update the risk matrix after 2pm.

—Karthik
From: product@sigmaapps.com <product@sigmaapps.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Dec 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Contract testing and schema alignment — SigmaApps integration

Hi Marissa / Neha —

Thanks for the heads up. We're seeing a mismatch in the routing-config payload (the new optional metadata envelope). Our eng lead, Daniel (daniel@sigmaapps.com), suggests a short compatibility shim on our side that should be live by 2026-12-30, but we need confirmation on exact field names and an ETA on the staging contract.

Can Redwood provide the staging contract link and a small sample payload? Also, is there a preferred SLA for retry/backoff in the new envelope?

Regards,
SigmaApps Integrations Team
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Daniel <daniel@sigmaapps.com>, procurement@northbridge.io
Date: Fri, 18 Dec 2026 16:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quarterly checkpoint: roadmap orchestration & launch horizon

All —

Thanks for the rapid inputs. Summary and agreed actions (for exec deck):

1) Launch windows: network-optimization remains slated for 2027-01-12 (conditional). routing-config remains tentative for 2027-01-26 pending chaos/load test gates.

2) Top risks + mitigations (one-liners, to be shown in the QBR slide):
  - KV cache regressions under burst -> extended soak + feature flagged rollout (Vivek).
  - 95th pctl latency at scale -> weekend chaos test; hold 1 sprint if >10% SLO miss (Vivek).
  - Model-compat drift on quantized execution -> run compat suite; prefer unquantized variant if drift >0.5% (Karthik).
  - SigmaApps contract/schema gap -> Sigma to ship compatibility shim by 2026-12-30; Redwood to provide staging contract and sample payload (Marissa/Neha).
  - Infra procurement lead-time -> confirm burst capacity via cloud partner marketplace (Karthik/Procurement).

3) Near-term asks (owners and ETA):
  - Vivek: run soak + chaos test results by 2026-12-19 EOD.
  - Karthik: run model-compat tests and post results to INF-4729 by 2026-12-20.
  - Marissa: confirm SigmaApps staging contract link and comms draft by 2026-12-19 noon.
  - Procurement (CC'd): verify spare burst capacity availability by 2026-12-20.

4) Exec deck: I'll prepare a one-slide risk snapshot and a proposed contingency (phased rollout + customer comms) and circulate prior to the Monday pre-brief. Please flag any changes by EOD.

Forwarding SigmaApps response to Marissa for staging details.

Neha Kapoor
VP, Product Operations
Redwood Inference
